# 16 Render the bottom participant box row

## Outcome

A plain `origin: "declared"` participant that is never destroyed renders its box/actor icon
twice — once at the diagram's participant row and once again at the bottom of the diagram,
matching Mermaid's own sequence-diagram output and the board's SVG conventions. A `create`d
participant still renders exactly once (at its creation row), and a destroyed participant still
renders exactly once plus its X mark. `layoutSequence` reserves the vertical space the bottom
row needs so the bottom boxes sit inside the diagram's reported `height`.

## Why this ticket exists

Found in review of tickets 13/14: the SVG convention "rendered ... again at the bottom unless
the participant is destroyed" was never implemented — `renderSequenceToSVG` emits exactly one
`<g class="siren-participant">` per participant, at `participant.top`. That made two of ticket
14's acceptance criteria ("no second participant group at the bottom", "renders a created
participant exactly once") pass vacuously, and would make spec.md's own `destroy` acceptance
criterion pass for the wrong reason at the `render()` level too. This ticket closes the gap so
those criteria become load-bearing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A `participant`/`actor` declared in the preamble and never destroyed renders two
  `<g class="siren-participant" data-siren-id="{id}">` groups: one at its lifeline top, one at
  the bottom row, both carrying the same id and the same shape (rect+text, or stick figure for
  `actor`).
- [ ] A `create`d participant renders exactly one group, at its creation row — no bottom box.
- [ ] A destroyed participant renders exactly one group plus its `siren-destroy-mark` — no
  bottom box, whether it was `create`d or preamble-declared.
- [ ] Each participant's `<line class="siren-lifeline">` still spans its own extent, unchanged
  by the added bottom row.
- [ ] `layoutSequence` reserves vertical space for the bottom row: every bottom box's rect sits
  within the returned `height`, and a diagram with no eligible participants (all created or all
  destroyed) reserves none.
- [ ] Ticket 09's existing `renders one siren-participant group per participant...` test is
  updated in the same change to reflect the new expected count, rather than left asserting the
  old behavior.

## Test seam

`layoutSequence(model, options): PositionedSequenceDiagram` (unit, fake `TextMeasurer`) and
`renderSequenceToSVG(diagram): SVGSVGElement` (component, jsdom) — both already established
seams for this pipeline stage.
